name: Suisei Tenshi Primaveil Zwei
original_name: 彗聖天使プリマヴェールZwei
source:
You have two missions in this game. One is to give sex training to Flare and Luna. Luna is already in your hand, and you'll need to catch Flare at first. Give them erotic and insulting sex lessons! The other mission is to conquer the world. Get ahead and complete the missions!

[From ErogeShop]
